# Threads Featured Posts
> Pure front-end static web application for displaying, paginating, and filtering featured Threads posts with exponential rate-limiting backoff, responsive masonry layout, and PWA offline caching.

## Ecosystem Integration
- Upstream Collector: threads-embedded-code (Google Chrome Extension, https://github.com/Scorpio-meow/threads-embedded-code.git). Automatically captures, sanitizes DOM noise, and exports structured post datasets while browsing Threads.
- Downstream Presentation: Threads-Featured-Posts (Static Web App, https://github.com/Scorpio-meow/Threads-Featured-Posts.git). Ingests the exported posts array in config.js to provide a robust, rate-limited, filtered, and responsive showcase interface.
- License: MIT ([LICENSE](./LICENSE))

## Core Files & Directory Structure
- index.html: Primary semantic HTML structure containing search inputs, dark/light theme toggles, hashtag container, masonry/list layout wrappers, pagination controls, loading progress panel, and FAQ diagnostic modal.
- config.js: Post data repository (posts array) and runtime rate-limiting/rendering configuration constants (LOAD_DELAY, BATCH_SIZE, EMBED_STAGGER_DELAY, etc.).
- threads-loader.js: Primary runtime controller managing pagination calculation, queue scheduling, rate-limit backoff handling, iframe lifecycle monitoring, DOM shimmer skeleton rendering, tag frequency statistics, real-time search filtering, and progress metrics telemetry.
- console-filter.js: Global error and warning interceptor that suppresses Threads embed script cross-origin 404 noise and dispatches threads:rate-limit custom events upon detecting HTTP 429 status.
- styles.css: Design token system with CSS custom properties, Light/Dark theme styles, native CSS columns masonry layout, skeleton shimmer animations, and glassmorphism UI components.
- sw.js: Progressive Web App (PWA) Service Worker implementing 32-bit djb2 content hashing across core files for automated cache invalidation and offline asset serving.
- manifest.json: Web App Manifest specification for desktop and mobile home screen installation.
- README.md: Comprehensive Traditional Chinese documentation with architecture diagrams, runtime configuration tables, and developer guide.
- README_EN.md: Comprehensive English documentation mirroring the full architectural and technical specification.
- llms.txt: Structured technical specifications for AI agents and LLM/RAG indexing pipelines.

## Data Types & Schema

### PostItem Interface (posts array in config.js)
```typescript
interface PostItem {
  /** Threads official blockquote HTML embed code string */
  embedCode: string;

  /** Canonical URL to the original Threads post */
  postLink: string;

  /** Author username handle without @ prefix */
  author: string;

  /** Extracted plaintext content of the post */
  content: string;

  /** Array of extracted hashtags and keyword topics */
  tags: string[];
}
```

### RuntimeConfig Interface (config.js constants)
```typescript
interface RuntimeConfig {
  /** Base delay between consecutive post loads in ms (default: 4000) */
  LOAD_DELAY: number;

  /** Maximum concurrent iframe loads limit (default: 1 for rate-limit safety) */
  BATCH_SIZE: number;

  /** Stagger delay between adjacent post requests in ms (default: 3600) */
  EMBED_STAGGER_DELAY: number;

  /** Individual iframe render timeout threshold in ms (default: 3600) */
  IFRAME_TIMEOUT: number;

  /** Initial presence check threshold in ms (default: 8000) */
  MIN_IFRAME_TIMEOUT: number;

  /** Base backoff duration on HTTP 429 error in ms (default: 60000, 1.5x scaling up to 300s) */
  RATE_LIMIT_BACKOFF: number;

  /** Maximum ceiling for dynamic delay in ms (default: 60000) */
  MAX_DELAY: number;

  /** Minimum safety interval between consecutive requests in ms (default: 3600) */
  MIN_DELAY_BETWEEN_REQUESTS: number;

  /** Maximum active DOM card nodes kept in active memory (default: 30) */
  MAX_VISIBLE_QUEUE: number;

  /** Available page size options array in dropdown (default: [1, 3, 5, 10, 25, 50]) */
  PAGE_SIZE_OPTIONS: number[];

  /** Default number of posts rendered per page (default: 10) */
  PAGE_SIZE: number;
}
```

### URLParams Interface (URL Query Parameters)
```typescript
interface URLParams {
  /** Target page index (1-based integer) */
  page?: number;

  /** Number of items rendered per page */
  page_size?: number;

  /** Seed timestamp string for deterministic random shuffle */
  random?: string;

  /** Search query string matching author, content, or tags */
  search?: string;

  /** Exact hashtag filter (excluding #) */
  tag?: string;

  /** Single post isolated preview mode (URL string or index) */
  post?: string;

  /** Enable debug logging in console and bypass filter */
  debug?: '1';
}
```

## Key Algorithms & Operational Mechanisms

### 1. Exponential Rate-Limiting Backoff
- console-filter.js intercepts 429, rate limit, or too many requests patterns and dispatches the `threads:rate-limit` event.
- threads-loader.js catches the event, immediately pauses the queue, shows a live countdown banner on the progress panel, and calculates backoff time (`currentBackoff * 1.5` up to 300s).
- Once the timer expires, the queue safely resumes loading remaining embeds.

### 2. Chunked Non-Blocking DOM Rendering with Shimmer Skeletons
- Uses `requestIdleCallback` (with `setTimeout` fallback) to mount DOM cards without blocking main-thread user interactions, keeping Interaction to Next Paint (INP) minimal.
- Displays skeleton placeholders with shimmer CSS animations to maintain visual stability before embed resolution.

### 3. Deterministic Seeded Pseudo-Random Shuffle
- Shuffling generates a timestamp seed preserved in URL `?random=<seed>`.
- A linear congruential generator uses this seed to guarantee identical post sorting order during pagination and page refresh.

### 4. Iframe Health Observers & Graceful Fallback
- Uses `MutationObserver` to watch iframe insertion and `ResizeObserver` to monitor rendered height.
- If an iframe fails to render, times out, or stays under 200px height (indicating block/error), it is gracefully replaced with a fallback card containing author info and direct Threads link.

### 5. 32-bit djb2 Dynamic Service Worker Cache Invalidation
- `sw.js` reads source code of core files (index.html, styles.css, threads-loader.js, config.js, console-filter.js, manifest.json), computes a unified 32-bit djb2 hash, and creates versioned caches automatically.
- Any file modifications trigger cache recreation and stale cache deletion on install/activate.

### 6. DOM Security & Safe Rendering
- Strict protection against DOM XSS: User-supplied and dataset text strings are rendered using text nodes or safe attribute bindings rather than raw `innerHTML`.
- Dynamic style attributes use validated values to prevent script injection.

## Development & Serving Commands
- VS Code Live Server extension: Open `index.html` via "Open with Live Server" (`http://127.0.0.1:5500`).
- Static server execution via Bun (CLI):
  ```bash
  bunx http-server -p 3000
  ```
- Access application:
  http://localhost:3000

## Known Constraints & Troubleshooting
- Threads Embed Authentication: Official Threads embed iframes require the user's browser to be logged into Threads and "Do Not Track" to be disabled; otherwise fallback links are displayed.
- Rate Limiting Defense: Maintain BATCH_SIZE = 1 and EMBED_STAGGER_DELAY >= 3600 in config.js to ensure long-term uninterrupted embed rendering.
- Diagnostic Mode: Append `?debug=1` to the URL to view unmasked console errors and timing telemetry.
